description: Island-wide impact at a sea-level rise (or a year and scenario): share of Singapore's land flooded, buildings reached, residents living in flooded areas.

rise_m.description: Sea-level rise in metres above today's mean high water (0-9).

scenario.description: moderate = SSP2-4.5, high = SSP5-8.5, upper = SSP5-8.5 high end (planning). Default high.

storm_surge.description: Add an extreme storm surge and high tide (+1.3 m) on top.

year.description: A year, 2025-2150 (with scenario), instead of rise_m.

name: flood_impact
